## Acceptance criteria for first release

- [ ] CI green on Linux.
- [ ] Quickstart commands in README work on a fresh checkout.
- [ ] Packaging: `npm install` / `pip install` / `go install` succeeds from a clean environment.
- [ ] At least one contract or snapshot test.
- [ ] One fixture-based integration test.
- [ ] At least one happy-path and one failure-path transcript per target agent.
